mapper.select: SELECT mobile_enabled FROM system_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(parameter_value AS SIGNED) FROM system_parameter WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parameter_key = #{parameterKey} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT parameter_value FROM system_parameter WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parameter_key = #{parameterKey} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code = 'RUNNING'), 0) AS running, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code = 'STOPPED'), 0) AS stopped, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code IN ('FAULT', 'REPAIR')), 0) AS fault, COALESCE(SUM(current_status.status_code = 'OFFLINE'), 0) AS offline FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status current_status ON current_status.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND current_status.equipment_id = e.id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.status = 1 AND e.deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED'), 0) AS open, COALESCE(SUM(abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.severity = 'CRITICAL'), 0) AS critical, COALESCE(SUM(abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.severity = 'HIGH'), 0) AS high FROM inspection_abnormal abnormal JOIN inspection_task task ON task.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND task.id = abnormal.task_id AND task.deleted = 0 WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND abnormal.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) )

SELECT DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) AS start_date, CURRENT_DATE() AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS due, COALESCE(SUM(task.task_status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_abnormal abnormal WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND abnormal.task_id = task.id AND abnormal.deleted = 0 )), 0) AS abnormal FROM inspection_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND task.planned_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE() AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) )

SELECT message_type, severity, title, content, occurred_time, route_path FROM ( SELECT 'INSPECTION_OVERDUE' AS message_type, 'HIGH' AS severity, CONCAT('点检任务逾期：', task.task_code) AS title, CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · 截止 ', DATE_FORMAT(task.due_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) AS content, COALESCE(task.updated_time, task.due_time) AS occurred_time, CONCAT('/mobile/inspection?taskId=', task.id) AS route_path FROM inspection_task task JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND e.id = task.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) ) AND ( task.task_status = 'OVERDUE' OR ( task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND task.due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'MAINTENANCE_OVERDUE', 'HIGH', CONCAT('维保任务逾期：', task.task_code), CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · 截止 ', DATE_FORMAT(task.due_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')), COALESCE(task.updated_time, task.due_time), CONCAT('/mobile/maintenance?taskId=', task.id) FROM maintenance_task task JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND e.id = task.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_collaborator collaborator WHERE collaborator.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND collaborator.task_id = task.id AND collaborator.user_id = #{userId} ) ) AND ( task.task_status = 'OVERDUE' OR ( task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND task.due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'INSPECTION_ABNORMAL', abnormal.severity, CONCAT('点检异常：', abnormal.abnormal_title), CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · ', abnormal.abnormal_description), abnormal.created_time, '/mobile/messages' FROM inspection_abnormal abnormal JOIN inspection_task task ON task.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND task.id = abnormal.task_id AND task.deleted = 0 JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND e.id = abnormal.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) ) UNION ALL SELECT 'MAINTENANCE_ABNORMAL', abnormal.severity, CONCAT('维保异常：', abnormal.abnormal_title), CONCAT(e.equipment_name, ' · ', abnormal.abnormal_description), abnormal.created_time, '/mobile/messages' FROM maintenance_abnormal abnormal JOIN maintenance_task task ON task.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND task.id = abnormal.task_id AND task.deleted = 0 JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = abnormal.tenant_id AND e.id = abnormal.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} AND abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.deleted = 0 ) message ORDER BY occurred_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, category.category_name, organization.organization_name, location.location_name, COALESCE(current_status.status_code, 'OFFLINE') AS status_code, COALESCE(palette.status_name, '离线') AS status_name, COALESCE(palette.display_color, '#64748b') AS status_color, current_status.status_since, responsible.real_name AS responsible_name FROM equipment_barcode barcode JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = barcode.tenant_id AND e.id = barcode.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1 JOIN equipment_category category ON category.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND category.id = e.category_id AND category.deleted = 0 JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND organization.id = e.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 JOIN location ON location.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND location.id = e.location_id AND location.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status current_status ON current_status.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND current_status.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN visualization_status_color palette ON palette.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND palette.status_code = COALESCE(current_status.status_code, 'OFFLINE') AND palette.status = 1 AND palette.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_user responsible ON responsible.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND responsible.id = e.primary_responsible_user_id AND responsible.deleted = 0 WHERE barcode.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND barcode.access_token = #{token} AND barcode.active_slot = 1 AND LIMIT 1

SELECT task_id, task_code, workflow_type, scheme_name, task_status, due_time, route_path FROM ( SELECT task.id AS task_id, task.task_code, 'INSPECTION' AS workflow_type, task.scheme_name_snapshot AS scheme_name, task.task_status, task.due_time, CONCAT('/mobile/inspection?taskId=', task.id) AS route_path FROM inspection_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND task.deleted = 0 AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_task_assignee assignee WHERE assignee.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND assignee.task_id = task.id AND assignee.user_id = #{userId} ) ) UNION ALL SELECT task.id, task.task_code, 'MAINTENANCE', task.scheme_name_snapshot, task.task_status, task.due_time, CONCAT('/mobile/maintenance?taskId=', task.id) FROM maintenance_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND task.deleted = 0 AND task.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND ( task.assignee_user_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM maintenance_task_collaborator collaborator WHERE collaborator.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND collaborator.task_id = task.id AND collaborator.user_id = #{userId} ) ) ) active ORDER BY due_time, task_id LIMIT 20

WITH RECURSIVE applicable_categories AS ( SELECT relation.scheme_version_id, category.id, relation.include_descendants_flag FROM inspection_scheme_category relation JOIN equipment_category category ON category.tenant_id = relation.tenant_id AND category.id = relation.equipment_category_id AND category.status = 1 AND category.deleted = 0 WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.scheme_version_id, child.id, parent.include_descendants_flag FROM equipment_category child JOIN applicable_categories parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id AND parent.include_descendants_flag = 1 WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.status = 1 AND child.deleted = 0 ) SELECT DISTINCT scheme.id AS scheme_id, version.id AS scheme_version_id, scheme.scheme_code, scheme.scheme_name, scheme.inspection_type, version.backfill_allowed_flag AS backfill_allowed FROM equipment e JOIN inspection_scheme scheme ON scheme.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND scheme.status = 1 AND scheme.deleted = 0 JOIN inspection_scheme_version version ON version.tenant_id = scheme.tenant_id AND version.id = scheme.current_version_id AND version.version_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND version.effective_date <= CURRENT_DATE() AND (version.expiry_date IS NULL OR version.expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE()) WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{equipmentId} AND e.status = 1 AND e.deleted = 0 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspection_scheme_equipment relation WHERE relation.tenant_id = version.tenant_id AND relation.scheme_version_id = version.id AND relation.equipment_id = e.id ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM applicable_categories category_scope WHERE category_scope.scheme_version_id = version.id AND category_scope.id = e.category_id ) ) ORDER BY scheme.scheme_name, scheme.id

SELECT user.id AS user_id, user.username, user.real_name, CASE WHEN organization.organization_type = 'TEAM' THEN organization.organization_code END AS team_code FROM system_user user LEFT JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = user.tenant_id AND organization.id = user.organization_id AND organization.status = 1 AND organization.deleted = 0 WHERE user.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user.status = 1 AND user.deleted = 0 ORDER BY user.real_name, user.username, user.id LIMIT 500

SELECT organization_code AS team_code, organization_name AS team_name FROM organization WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND organization_type = 'TEAM' AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY organization_name, id
